ideas.title: Minnesota Governor Race: A Look into the Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the massive fraud scandal that led to Tim Walz ending his re-election run and its implications on the governor race.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud scandal?
How will it impact the governor race?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the connection between the fraud scandal and the governor race, potentially uncovering more details about the scandal.
